self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: When Elemental Burst hits: ATK +40% (or +70% with Hexerei). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Nearby active party members other than the wearer gain ATK +32% for 3s (or +56% with Hexerei). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).
